the association between CRP and the metabolic syndrome is complex.

the relation of CRP to obesity, adiposity, insulin resistance, and other cardiovascular risk factors is not clear and that the role of CRP in the pathogenesis of obesity, insulin resistance, diabetes mellitus, hypertension, and atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease needs to be clarified in further studies.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
C-reactive protein is a marker of inflammation that is strongly related to the metabolic syndrome and cardiovascular disease.
CRP is an inflammatory marker that is associated with obesity and metabolic syndrome.

the relation between CRP, obesity and cardiovascular risk factors is not clear in men treated with PCI in course of acute MI, especially when we consider the fact that the CRP levels were not elevated in our patients.

the relationship between CRP and obesity is complex.
